sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks C11/D11; Internal Quality Checks D11; Deterministic Checks C2, C7, C11, C29)
evidence: Static configuration review; no configured judge run was performed or relied upon. (1) Isolation: task/task.toml:28 environment_mode = "separate"; the parsed [verifier] table (timeout, mode, env, environment) equals the frozen template's [verifier] table, and diff of task.toml against the template shows only [task]/[metadata] identity fields changed (lines 5-7, 10-12, 14-15). (2) Credentials: task.toml:30-35 [verifier.env] is byte-equal to the template block and to staged-task-contract.md:66-71: REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""; no CRLF; no literal secret (grep for sk-or/sk-ant/api_key across the task found only these lines). task.toml:37-38 network_mode = "public", no allowlist, which the row permits. (3) Pinned image: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile (diff empty). Bases node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim (lines 1-2); npm pins claude-code@2.1.281, codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 17-21); pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (line 31); Chromium installed by the pinned Playwright CLI bundled in @playwright/mcp (lines 33-38); COPY . /tests (line 43). apt packages are unversioned (lines 12-13), which workbook Deterministic C11 classes as a NOTE and which is template-controlled. (4) judge.toml: all five files have judge = "claude-code" at line 2 and parse with [judge] keys judge/mode/timeout/isolated/prompt_template/mcp_servers only; none contains model, reasoning effort or temperature. (5) tests/test.sh, tools/score.py and tools/restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the template; test.sh:63-64 refuses to run without REWARDKIT_JUDGE and REWARDKIT_MODEL, so the model can only come from task.toml. Counter-checks tried: a model smuggled into a judge.toml or test.sh (none found); a changed model/base URL/token name (byte-equal, none); a combined-environment verifier (separate). Limitation: raw-evidence-index.json covers scripted golden behaviour only, so live OpenRouter authentication with the wired key is unmeasured; that belongs to the launch-and-grade runtime row, not this configuration row.
